summary: In the November 2026 Visa Bulletin, F2B Final Action Dates advanced for 3 of 5 chargeability areas and held steady for 2.
All other countries, China (mainland-born) and India each advanced 366 days (≈12.0 months), from Aug 22, 2019 to Aug 22, 2020.
Mexico stayed at May 15, 2010 and the Philippines stayed at Oct 1, 2013.
USCIS says family-sponsored applicants use the Dates for Filing chart (Table B) for Form I-485 this month.

sections.heading: F2B Final Action Dates advanced for three areas and held for two
paragraphs: The Final Action Date (Table A) decides when a green card can be approved for a given priority date. For F2B (Unmarried Adult Sons and Daughters of Permanent Residents), All other countries, China (mainland-born) and India each moved from Aug 22, 2019 in October 2026 to Aug 22, 2020 in November 2026. That is an advance of 366 days (≈12.0 months) for each of the three.
Mexico did not change and remains at May 15, 2010. The Philippines did not change and remains at Oct 1, 2013.

sections.heading: F2B Dates for Filing show the same pattern as Final Action Dates
paragraphs: The Dates for Filing (Table B) for F2B also advanced 366 days (≈12.0 months) for All other countries, China (mainland-born) and India. Each moved from Sep 1, 2019 in October 2026 to Sep 1, 2020 in November 2026.
The F2B Table B dates for Mexico and the Philippines did not change. Mexico remains at Mar 22, 2011 and the Philippines remains at Oct 1, 2014.

sections.heading: Table B is further ahead of Table A for Mexico and the Philippines
paragraphs: Table B dates are later than Table A dates, so the gap shows how much further ahead the filing chart is. For All other countries, China (mainland-born) and India, the F2B Table B date is 10 days (≈0.3 months) ahead of Table A.
For Mexico, Table B is 311 days (≈10.2 months) ahead of Table A. For the Philippines, Table B is 365 days (≈12.0 months) ahead of Table A.

For November 2026, USCIS says family-sponsored applicants use the Dates for Filing chart (Table B) for Form I-485. If your priority date is earlier than the Table B date for your category and country, you may be able to file your adjustment of status application this month. Other eligibility requirements still apply.

sections.heading: The 6- and 12-bulletin record for F2B Final Action Dates
paragraphs: This record covers Final Action Dates (Table A) only. For All other countries, China (mainland-born) and India, the date went from May 22, 2017 to Aug 22, 2020 over the last 6 bulletins (since May 2026), a net gain of 1188 days (≈39.0 months). It advanced in 5 bulletins, was unchanged in 1 and retrogressed in 0. Over the last 12 bulletins (since November 2025), it went from Dec 1, 2016 to Aug 22, 2020, a net gain of 1360 days (≈44.7 months). It advanced in 6, was unchanged in 6 and retrogressed in 0.

Mexico went from Feb 15, 2009 to May 15, 2010 over the last 6 bulletins, a net gain of 454 days (≈14.9 months). It advanced in 1, was unchanged in 5 and retrogressed in 0. Over 12 bulletins it went from Dec 15, 2007 to May 15, 2010, a net gain of 882 days (≈29.0 months), with 4 advances, 8 unchanged and 0 retrogressions.

The Philippines went from Apr 8, 2013 to Oct 1, 2013 over the last 6 bulletins, a net gain of 176 days (≈5.8 months). It advanced in 3, was unchanged in 3 and retrogressed in 0. Over 12 bulletins it went from Oct 1, 2012 to Oct 1, 2013, a net gain of 365 days (≈12.0 months), with 6 advances, 6 unchanged and 0 retrogressions.
